# linear_release_pipeline (Resource)

Manages a Linear release pipeline — how a set of teams ships, and which paths in the repository count towards a release.

Destroying the resource archives the pipeline.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linear_release_pipeline" "web" {
  name          = "Web"
  type          = "continuous"
  is_production = true

  team_ids              = [linear_team.engineering.id]
  include_path_patterns = ["apps/web/**"]

  auto_generate_release_notes_on_completion = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pipeline.

### Optional

- `auto_generate_release_notes_on_completion` (Boolean) Whether Linear writes release notes itself when a release completes.
- `include_path_patterns` (List of String) Repository path patterns a change has to touch to belong to this pipeline, e.g. `["apps/web/**"]`. An empty list includes everything.
- `is_production` (Boolean) Whether this pipeline ships to production.
- `slug_id` (String) URL slug of the pipeline. Linear derives one from the name when unset.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the teams shipping through this pipeline.
- `type` (String) How the pipeline releases — `continuous` ships on merge, `scheduled` ships on a cadence.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the pipeline.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import linear_release_pipeline.example a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
